item.text:
{"source":"import Base

# A finite list denotes a stream with an absorbing zero tail.
def uncons0(cells: List<&2, U32>) -> U32 & List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      (0, Nil{})
    case Con{head, tail}:
      (head, tail)

# Horizontal windows restart at each row boundary.
def horizontal(cells: List<&2, U32>, +width: U32, +column: U32, left: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+here, +rest}:
      +next = U32.inc(column)
      +seam = U32.is_eq(next, width)
      (right, unused) = uncons0(rest)
      total = (left + here + Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, right) : U32)
      total <> horizontal(rest, width,
        Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, next),
        Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, here))

# Including the center changes B3/S23 into closed totals 3 and live 4.
def life(here: U32, +total: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(U32.is_eq(total, 3),
    Bool.and(U32.is_eq(here, 1), U32.is_eq(total, 4))))

# Consume three zero-extended streams in lockstep with the output shape.
def vertical(cells: List<&2, U32>, above: List<&2, U32>, middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{here, rest}:
      (north, norths) = uncons0(above)
      (center, centers) = uncons0(middle)
      (south, souths) = uncons0(below)
      total = (north + center + south : U32)
      life(here, total) <> vertical(rest, norths, centers, souths)

# Exact input length carries height; cells supplies the output shape.
def step(+width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  +band = horizontal(cells, width, 0, 0)
  above = List.append(&2, U32, List.replicate(U32, span, 0), band)
  below = List.drop(&2, U32, band, span)
  vertical(cells, above, band, below)

def evolve(turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+remaining:
      evolve(remaining, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"The stimulus's axial symmetry suggests a separable neighborhood sum. The concrete revision treats each finite list as a zero-extended stream: uncons0 returns both the current value and its continuation, with empty mapping to (0, empty). Vertical traversal now consumes each stream once per output cell instead of separately inspecting its head and tail. This makes boundary behavior and cursor advancement one operation, removes reusable annotations from the three vertical cursors, and preserves the closed-neighborhood B3/S23 calculation.","findings":"Prior feedback reported passing runtime observations on Node, Bun and native, and no semantic issues. Those observations support retaining the separable stencil and evolution recursion. Style requirements were not met; the revision addresses repeated stream inspection and ownership overhead with a total stream destructor. Whether it improves the required style ratings remains unresolved. The revised source has not been compiled or independently evaluated here."}
